title: Tidal Slam
description: A cinematic downbeat impact built from two interlocked gestures: a reversed pink-noise swell with an LFO-driven rising filter that rushes upward over each cycle, crashing into a deep sine sub-boom with a steep pitch-drop envelope and cavernous reverb tail. The swell brightness, boom decay, filter resonance, and stereo width all travel on mutually-prime LFO clocks (8, 13, 17, 24 cycles) so the impact character shifts continuously across the 24-cycle arc.
code:
setcpm(96/4)
stack(
  // REVERSE SWELL — pink noise with rising filter (speed(-1) for reverse feel)
  s("pink*2")
    .speed(-1)
    .lpf(saw.slow(8).range(200, 8000))
    .resonance(sine.slow(13).range(2, 14))
    .gain(sine.slow(17).range(0.3, 0.9))
    .pan(sine.slow(24).range(0.15, 0.85))
    .shape(0.25)
    .room(0.8).delay("0.3:0.25:0.5")
    .orbit(1),

  // SUB BOOM — sine with massive downward pitch drop + huge space
  note("c1*2")
    .s("sine")
    .penv("<-36 -24>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(sine.slow(13).range(0.08, 0.3))
    .lpf(sine.slow(17).range(80, 600)).resonance(sine.slow(8).range(1, 8)).ftype("ladder")
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.4).sustain(0.0).release(0.2)
    .gain(sine.slow(24).range(0.7, 1.1))
    .shape(0.4).distort(0.3)
    .room(0.95).delay("0.15:0.5:0.4")
    .orbit(2)
)
